실행절차 (To-Be/Oracle): /* 재시험 시에만 : 백업 후 오늘 행 초기화 */ / CREATE TABLE SSP_MST_SHIP_PLAN_SCHEDULE_BAK<YYYYMMDD> AS / SELECT * / FROM SSP_MST_SHIP_PLAN_SCHEDULE / WHERE PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD BETWEEN TO_CHAR(SYSDATE - 1, 'YYYYMMDD') AND TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD'); / UPDATE SSP_MST_SHIP_PLAN_SCHEDULE / SET ERP_STOCK_CUTOFF_YN = 'N' / , OWMS_STOCK_CUTOFF_YN = 'N' / , CURRENT_PLAN_DATE_YN = 'N' / , LAST_UPDATE_DATE = SYSDATE / , LAST_UPDATED_BY = :USER_ID / WHERE PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD') / AND COMPANY_ID = :COMPANY_ID;
